description_en: Dissociates an asset from an Anti-DDoS Origin instance of a paid edition
description_zh: 删除资产组和防护包实例绑定关系
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp dettach-asset-group-to-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id ddosbgp-xxx --asset-group-list Type=waf Region=cn-hangzhou Name=waf_v2_public_cn-lbj382l0000 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DettachAssetGroupToInstance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region in which the instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所属地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances of paid editions
parameters.help_zh:
要删除绑定的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the asset. If the asset is a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance, specify the ID of the WAF instance
fields.help_zh: 资产组名称。对于WAF，指WAF的实例ID
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The region ID of the asset
fields.name: region

fields.help_en:
The type of the asset. Valid values:

waf: WAF instance

ga: Global Accelerator (GA) instance
fields.help_zh:
资产组类型。取值：
waf：表示WAF资产。
ga：表示GA资产
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The information about the asset that you want to dissociate
parameters.name: asset_group_list
